from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,struct,sys
from read_amdgpu_metadata_r1 import metadata
REFERENCE='https://llvm.org/docs/AMDGPUUsage.html#code-object-v3-kernel-descriptor'
MODE_REFERENCE='https://llvm.org/docs/AMDGPUUsage.html#compute-pgm-rsrc1-for-gfx6-gfx12'

def inspect(path):
 data=path.read_bytes();objects=metadata(data);assert objects,'No AMDGPU ELF metadata'
 result=[]
 for obj in objects:
  begin=obj['elf_offset'];elf=struct.unpack_from('<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH',data,begin)
  assert elf[2]==224 and elf[11]==64
  sections=[struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQIIQQ',data,begin+elf[6]+i*64) for i in range(elf[12])]
  symbols={}
  for sec in sections:
   if sec[1] not in (2,11):continue
   assert sec[9]==24
   strings=sections[sec[6]];raw_strings=data[begin+strings[4]:begin+strings[4]+strings[5]]
   for i in range(sec[5]//24):
    name,info,other,index,value,size=struct.unpack_from('<IBBHQQ',data,begin+sec[4]+i*24)
    if not index or index>=len(sections):continue
    symbol=raw_strings[name:raw_strings.index(b'\0',name)].decode()
    if not symbol.endswith('.kd'):continue
    assert (info&15)==1 and size==64,(symbol,info,size)
    target=sections[index];offset=begin+target[4]+value-target[3]
    assert 0<=value-target[3]<=target[5]-64
    desc=data[offset:offset+64];assert len(desc)==64
    if symbol in symbols:assert symbols[symbol]==(offset,desc)
    symbols[symbol]=(offset,desc)
  for kernel in obj['metadata']['amdhsa.kernels']:
   name=kernel['.symbol'];offset,desc=symbols[name]
   for i,key in enumerate(('.group_segment_fixed_size','.private_segment_fixed_size','.kernarg_segment_size')):
    assert struct.unpack_from('<I',desc,i*4)[0]==kernel[key],(name,key)
   rsrc1=struct.unpack_from('<I',desc,48)[0];mode='wgp' if rsrc1&(1<<29) else 'cu'
   properties=struct.unpack_from('<H',desc,56)[0];wave=32 if properties&(1<<10) else 64
   assert wave==kernel['.wavefront_size'],(name,wave)
   result.append(dict(elf_offset=begin,descriptor_offset=offset,symbol=name,descriptor_hex=desc.hex(),compute_pgm_rsrc1=rsrc1,gpu_execution_mode=mode,wavefront_size=wave,vgpr_count=kernel['.vgpr_count'],sgpr_count=kernel['.sgpr_count'],group_segment_fixed_size=kernel['.group_segment_fixed_size'],private_segment_fixed_size=kernel['.private_segment_fixed_size']))
 assert result
 return dict(file=path.name,bytes=len(data),sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),kind='actual_embedded_amdgpu_kernel_descriptors',descriptor_reference=REFERENCE,mode_reference=MODE_REFERENCE,reference_verified_utc='2026-09-16',compute_pgm_rsrc1_byte_offset=48,wgp_mode_bit=29,mode_counts={v:sum(k['gpu_execution_mode']==v for k in result) for v in ('cu','wgp')},wavefront_counts={str(v):sum(k['wavefront_size']==v for k in result) for v in (32,64)},kernels=result)
if __name__=='__main__':
 result=inspect(Path(sys.argv[1]));output=Path(sys.argv[2])
 with output.open('x') as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
 print({k:result[k] for k in ('file','sha256','mode_counts','wavefront_counts')})

decision.disposition: Keep the build default unchanged; do not replace the retained provider stack with the CU set.
decision.reason: Both same-source q8192/out512 arms pass every GB10 token, first logit and actual callback. The single CU observation improves TTFT by206.1026ms but increases TPOT by1.616852ms. This pair does not establish a repeatable or mission-scale improvement. Both TTFT results remain above10seconds; the4187.415605ms retained target is unchanged.
decision.scope: Four in-tree HIP providers; precompiled AOT, external math libraries and CLI unchanged. No other prompt, prefix, long-context, package or release qualification transfers.
decision.next_direction: Audit actual launch sizes against compiler workgroup limits and resource allocation in dominant kernels, then choose a broad measured route.
